source_sync.timing: Delta hashes checked before documentation and delivery updates; production and build sources remain identical to the tested artifact.

production_source_comparison.interpretation: All executable/config/build sources match the cloud artifact; only listed prior user extensions differ. Later documentation does not change these runtime sources.

files.observations: All five package fields are visible and editable; the package activity window is 15000 us after rounding. The shared-scope explanation, complete 36-row table, CPU selection and unchanged/readback status are visible without clipping.

With PECI maximum and EPP overrides set, both local and package maximum/EPP rows are read only; package minimum, desired and activity-window rows remain editable. Stored package, PECI, polarity, notification and history values are separately displayed.

The Oracle Linux 7.9 fixture displays all five editable package fields, the shared-scope explanation, all 36 rows, the package-window selector and complete unchanged/readback status without clipping. The rounded activity window is 15000 us.

visual_review.scope: Visually inspected the three listed Debian 12 and Oracle Linux 7.9 fixture screenshots only; no claim that all generated screenshots were manually reviewed.

limits: Five package fields are editable under CPUID and enabled-HWP gates. Performance bounds use the selected logical CPU; stored hints do not measure delivered performance.
EL7 target is Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64; other RHEL/CentOS 7 configurations have not been certified.

Request sources are separate samples, not an atomic effective request. Package writes affect shared hints; no PECI, polarity, selection, notification or history writes, and no physical hardware acceptance.
Windows/macOS test the portable core, not a complete hardware backend.
ICCmax/VR, Vmax/extended TVB, remaining AMD and motherboard controls, and Secure Boot acceptance remain incomplete.

local_user_port_tests.context: Windows lacks native Linux/C++ tooling; applicable cloud checks execute without these skips. Existing user extensions retained.
